web-reader.description: Web page reader: fetch any URL and convert it to model-friendly markdown (title, body, metadata, links) with image and link-summary options; use it after search or for any URL you need to read

web-search-prime.description: Web search over the live internet: fresh, real-time information such as news, stock prices and weather; returns page title, URL and summary, with domain and recency filters

zread.description: GitHub repository explorer (zread.ai): search a repo's knowledge docs, issues and PRs, list its directory structure, and read any file in full; for studying external open-source repos and dependencies
